messages:
Alyssa (SRE): Morning — heads up, my train got cancelled due to the snow closure across the Bay. I'm primary for tonight's EU bridge (00:00-08:00 UTC) but can't make it to home office for a stable connection. Can someone cover primary? I'm still reachable but prefer handing off.
Mike (Oncall): Ack. I'm finishing a doc sprint but can cover primary for the overnight window if Jordan can take secondary. @Jordan any chance you can take secondary tonight?
Jordan (SRE): I can take secondary until 02:00 UTC, then I have a family thing. If Mike can hold 02:00->08:00 that works. Alternately I can be primary for first half.
Alyssa (SRE): Thanks. For clarity: primary currently has PD escalation path for 'redis-cache-high-errors' and 'streaming-timeout'. Runbook is here: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/eu-bridge. Key steps: check instance group, failover, and enforce routing policy. Quick copy:
```bash
# failover shorthand
./rctl failover --cluster redis-eu --to node-3
pd escalate redis-cache-high-errors
``` 
Mike (Oncall): I'll swap and take full primary 00:00->08:00 UTC. Jordan you comfortable with being primary handoff at 00:00->02:00? Jordan: confirm.
Jordan (SRE): I can do primary 00:00->02:00, then Mike take over at 02:00. I'll update PD overrides. I'll also post to #status-updates.
Mike (Oncall): Great. I'm going to update PagerDuty and the oncall roster. PD override command:
```text
pd incidents assign --incident redis-cache-high-errors --assignee mike
pd schedule override --user mike --start "2026-03-15T00:00:00Z" --end "2026-03-15T08:00:00Z"
``` 
ops-bot: Reminder: when handing off primary, update the 'current-primary' tag and confirm KV cache warming is done. See runbook section 3.
incident-bot: Pager incident 'redis-cache-high-errors' cleared 1976509950, but regression alerts still firing; suppression window recommended.
Alyssa (SRE): I'm going to file a short customer impact note: some customers in EU may have seen increased error rates for ~10m earlier. SalesOps and Support should get a heads-up. Linking to the incident postmortem template: https://redwood.internal/incidents/template
Jordan (SRE): Posted handoff in PD and #status-updates. I also pre-warmed the failover node and set cache TTL to 30s while we stabilize. 
Mike (Oncall): I'll monitor metrics for first 2 hours, set an alert for >3% error rate bump. Also scheduling a quick Zoom if it spikes.
Alyssa (SRE): Thanks team. I'm on remote standby reachable by DM. If anyone needs me to trigger the emergency network tunnel (company VPN), I can do it remotely. :snowflake:
Jordan (SRE): Noted. I'll take the first page if it fires. Mike — please confirm once you toggle PD override.
Mike (Oncall): Done — PD schedule override set. I've left a short checklist in the roster: primary-owner, secondary-owner, contact links, runbook pointer. Posting a short note to #eng-oncall so folks see the ad hoc swap.
Alyssa (SRE): Appreciate it. Leaving the thread open in case any customer-facing escalation is needed. 
ops-bot: Automated note: Oncall reassignment recorded — Alyssa -> Jordan (00:00-02:00), Jordan -> Mike (02:00-08:00).
